reason: The two MOPA scheduling proposals are low-risk tests that retain all four ZA tiles and the reduction order, though they may compile identically. K unrolling and a 512-specific version are plausible loop-overhead tests, with register-pressure risk. Compiler inspection and pointer changes have mixed or inconclusive supplied trials; the packing and streaming proposals have prior regressions, but those joint results do not establish causality. The transpose, tail, alignment, and cache-layout ideas have no direct measured support and add memory or addressing changes.
